description.value: Notch8 Restaurant & Bar is the signature dining room of the Fairmont Hotel Vancouver, one of the city's most storied heritage properties in the heart of downtown. Recognized as one of Canada's Top 50 Hotel Restaurants for 2025, it serves breakfast through late-night dinner and a celebrated Afternoon Tea program. The kitchen blends classic French technique with Pacific Northwest ingredients under Executive Chef Mike Reid.
